title: CRaFT: An Explanation-Based Framework for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with culturally grounded questions from the World Values Survey under fixed cultural identity prompts, and evaluating the generated explanations using embedding-based metrics (Cultural Fluency, Deviation, and Consistency) compared against cultural knowledge vectors derived from native concepts.

Comparing model responses and explanations for the exact same questions presented in English versus target languages (Arabic, Bengali, and Spanish) to measure Linguistic Adaptation and semantic reasoning shifts across linguistic boundaries.
